entries.title: Sauna
entries.final_prompt:
Create a premium collectible hobby illustration. The artwork should feel cinematic, aspirational, emotionally warm, commercially polished, and immediately readable on a small mobile card. Use a strong focal subject, crisp subject separation, rich but controlled colour, atmospheric depth, premium lighting, and clear visual storytelling. Sell the emotional fantasy of doing the hobby rather than merely depicting an object. Aim for the feel of a miniature lifestyle poster or hero illustration inside one coherent collectible-art universe. Keep edges and subject readability cleaner than soft editorial painting. No text, no logo, no typography, no card border, no rarity badge, no watermark, no UI.

Use this overall composition approach: Show a specific wellness venue or sensory ritual in progress, with body position, water/heat/treatment/sound context, and environment coherently identifying the experience. Calm medium or medium-wide experiential framing. The emotional feeling should be reset, sensation, recovery, calm. Make the hobby immediately recognizable through Person plus unmistakable wellness-experience environment or equipment..

Compose the specific scene this way: The sauna/heat-room experience is unmistakable through wood/stone heat context, seated relaxed posture, and atmospheric warmth without branding. Human-height medium interior view. Use Warm low-contrast heat-room glow..

Use this colour and material direction: soft restrained tones with clean light. specific activity anchor required.

Depict this activity: A person safely relaxing in a generic Sauna, with seated posture and the heat-room environment clearly visible

Place it in this believable setting: A believable unbranded wood or stone sauna interior

The emotional tone should feel calm, balance, renewal, self-mastery.

Keep these hobby-recognition cues visible: one specific Sauna action, human participation, clear wellness context.

The scene must include: recognisable sauna interior, safe seated wellness posture.

Do not depict any of the following: generic wellness stock pose, medical claims or clinical treatment imagery, logos or readable product labels, medical procedure imagery, generic spa-stock portrait, unsafe heat/cold behavior, brand signage or product labels.
